generation.scope: Every smooth elliptic quintic point graph in a finite Frobenius four-edge graph window has j=1728 and translation four-shift. Each projection center is an eigenline for one of two cyclic order-five groups. Each adjacent relation space is the entire mixed multiplication kernel. All four positions have the same order-five subgroup and adjacent translations do not differ by five-torsion. Two explicit reference embeddings and a finite list of torsion offsets reduce the candidates to finitely many one-parameter elliptic families. Sufficiency is open.
